obstruction.statement: the fixed wall space H_wall is not proved invariant under Fourier transform
obstruction.reason: its norm controls piecewise derivative and jumps at {log p}, but not the position moment t f needed to control a derivative of Fourier(f); Fourier images of wall deltas are global oscillatory response tails, not jumps at prime logarithms
obstruction.forbidden_shortcut: declare Fourier unitary on H_wall merely because it is unitary on ambient L2

four_presentations.transported: H^(j) is the completion of F^j(H_wall core) with transported norm ||F^j f||_(j):=||f||_wall, j=1,2,3
four_presentations.important: the four copies are presentation-labelled carriers; their norms are transported rather than identified with one fixed broken-H1 norm

orbit_carrier.name: H_orb=H^(0) direct_sum H^(1) direct_sum H^(2) direct_sum H^(3)
orbit_carrier.quarter_turn: T_orb(h_0,h_1,h_2,h_3)=(F^(-3)h_3,Fh_0,Fh_1,Fh_2), with each displayed F interpreted as the defining isometry between adjacent transported presentations

horizontal_source_graph.quarter_covariance: T_orb J_orb f=J_orb(Ff) whenever f and its orbit are read in the transported source presentations
horizontal_source_graph.source_recovery: 2 times projection to presentation zero recovers f

incidence_lift.wall_handling: prime jumps remain explicit in presentation zero; Fourier-transformed oscillatory tails live in transported response presentations rather than being mis-typed as prime-wall jumps

sewing_graph.maximal_isotropic: follows from unitarity under the standard -I direct_sum I Green form

remaining_physical_descent: construct the horizontal equalizer identifying four presentations as one state without replacing them by an independent direct sum
transport reciprocal signs and Real structure across all strata
show conservative C_FP trace lands in the sewing graph
prove ordered linking form continuity on the orbit carrier
disposition: Fourier sewing can be made rigorously unitary by retaining four transported presentation spaces. This avoids the false requirement that the prime-wall broken-H1 norm itself be Fourier invariant. The orbit graph closes analytic sewing, while horizontal physical-state descent and linking remain separate.
